headline: UK JOBS 🏢💼 WON'T MAKE YOU REVEAL salWHOREy HISTORY 😩🍆
text:
BREAKING 🚨📰 NEWS for all the JOB 💼🍆 HUNGRY HOES 🧑‍💼🍑‼️ employers can 📞 still ASK 😏 how much 💵 you're currently 🤑 GETTING PAID 💰🍆 in your role 👔 but you DON'T 🚫 have to SPILL 😳 the salWHOREy 💰 beans 📢 during interVIEWing 🪑👀‼️ Louise Rudd 👩‍💼 from ACAS 🔥 says there's zero rules 🚫 stopping the question ❓ but they gotta 🫵 ask EVERYONE 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 the same 🟰 so it's FAIR ⚖️ and not 🚫 discriminatory 🛡️😌

The Fawcett Society 👥 and REC 🏢 pushed #EndSalaryHistory 🏳️‍🌈 to stop ⛔ perpetuating unfair 😣 pay gaps 📉 from gender ♀️ race and disability ♿ so candidates 🧑‍💼 can focus 🎯 on their SKILLS 🍆 and exPECtations 💭 instead of past 📜 loads 💦📉‼️ EU is banning 🇪🇺 salary history 💰 probes entirely 🌍🚫 but UK 🇬🇧 Cabinet is just making 📢 employers publish 📊 the pay range upfront 📜💸 so you walk 🚶 in knowing 🧠 the market 📈 rate and can 🤝 negotiate your full 🎁 PACKAGE 😩🍑 DADDY ACAS 👨‍💼 keeps reminding 🔁 everyone to stay 😎 confident and realistic 📏 while showcasing 🌟 your true 🧾 VALUE 🤑💪 without lying 🤥 and risking 🚨 getting BUSTED 😭

❌ 0 back = your next 💼 OFFERING stays 📌 based on your old 😣 tiny salWHOREy 😭💸
